select PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, PTL_PORTFOLIO.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno, PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM invAim, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_01} THEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END)) prinAmtTheory, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_02} THEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END)) chargeUnpayInterest, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_03} THEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END)) repaymentUnpayInterest, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_01} THEN fxxx.ysk ELSE 0 END)) capitalHoldPosition, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_02} THEN fxxx.ysk ELSE 0 END)) interestHoldPosition, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_03} THEN fxxx.ysk ELSE 0 END)) repaymentUnpayHoldPosition, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_01} THEN fxxx.fxje ELSE 0 END)) capitalPenaltyTotle, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_02} THEN fxxx.fxje ELSE 0 END)) interestPenaltyTotle, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_03} THEN fxxx.fxje ELSE 0 END)) repaymentUnpayHoldPenaltyTotle, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_01} THEN fxxx.sffxje ELSE 0 END)) actPenaltyIntBj, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_02} THEN fxxx.sffxje ELSE 0 END)) actPenaltyIntLx, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_03} THEN fxxx.sffxje ELSE 0 END)) actPenaltyIntHbWfx, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_01} THEN drfs.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END)) earlyPrinAmtTheory, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_02} THEN drfs.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END)) earlyChargeUnpayInterest, sum((CASE WHEN PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE=#{RECE_TYPE_03} THEN drfs.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END)) earlyRepaymentUnpayInterest, PTL_RECE_POSITION.PAY_DATE payDate from PTL_RECE_POSITION left join PTL_PORTFOLIO on PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID and PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} left join VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT on PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH=VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.WITHOUT_BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID=VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.FINPRODID left join (select sum(PENALTY_INT_AMT) fxje, sum(RECE_AMT) ysk, FINPROD_ID,BRANCH, PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_SEC_RECEIVABLES where PTL_SEC_RECEIVABLES.CDATE= #{Cdate}- 1 group by FINPROD_ID,BRANCH,PORTFOLIO_ID) fxxx on PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = fxxx.FINPROD_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH = fxxx.BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = fxxx.PORTFOLIO_ID left join (select TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.INV_AIM, sum((CASE WHEN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS=#{PS_T01} THEN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT*(-1) ELSE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT END)) sffxje from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID where TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BUSI_TYPE= #{BUSI_TYPE_37} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS= #{TRADE_STATUS_01} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL= #{YES_OR_NO_N} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE=#{Cdate} group by TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.INV_AIM ) sffx on PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = sffx.FINPROD_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH = sffx.BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = sffx.PORTFOLIO_ID and (IFNULL(IFNULL(sffx.CHL_ID,sffx.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID),'999999')=PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID) and PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM = sffx.INV_AIM left join (select ptl_rece_position_flow.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.BRANCH, ptl_rece_position_flow.FINPROD_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.SEC_ACCT_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.INV_AIM, sum(ptl_rece_position_flow.AMOUNT) AMOUNT from ptl_rece_position_flow where ptl_rece_position_flow.CDATE = #{Cdate} AND (ptl_rece_position_flow.INPUT_TYPE != #{INPUT_TYPE_04} or ptl_rece_position_flow.INPUT_TYPE is null) and ptl_rece_position_flow.HODING_TYPE= #{POSITION_TYPE_03} group by ptl_rece_position_flow.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.BRANCH, ptl_rece_position_flow.FINPROD_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.SEC_ACCT_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.INV_AIM) drfs on PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = drfs.PORTFOLIO_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH= drfs.BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID =drfs.FINPROD_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID = drfs.SEC_ACCT_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM = drfs.INV_AIM WHERE PTL_RECE_POSITION.HODING_TYPE= #{POSITION_TYPE_03} and PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} and PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} and PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId}
and (PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH =#{liBranch} OR VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.BRANCH=#{liBranch})
and (PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH =#{bjBranch})
and (PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH in(#{bjBranch},#{liBranch}) OR VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.BRANCH=#{liBranch})
and PTL_RECE_POSITION.CDATE = #{Cdate} group by PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME, PTL_PORTFOLIO.INVEST_YESORNO, PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID, PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM, PTL_RECE_POSITION.PAY_DATE
select branch bjBranch, TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, FINPROD_ID finprodId, IFNULL(IFNULL(SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,CHL_ID),'999999') secAcctId from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{busiCode}
